items.q: A heterozygous plant (Tt) is crossed with a short plant (tt). What percentage of offspring are short?
items.qAf: ’n Heterosigotiese plant (Tt) word met ’n kort plant (tt) gekruis. Watter persentasie van die nageslag is kort?
items.explain: Tt × tt gives Tt and tt in a 1 : 1 ratio, so 50% are short.
items.explainAf: Tt × tt gee Tt en tt in ’n 1 : 1-verhouding, dus is 50% kort.

items.q: Tall (T) is dominant over short (t). In a Tt × Tt cross, what is the phenotypic ratio of tall to short offspring?
items.qAf: Lang (T) is dominant oor kort (t). Wat is die fenotipiese verhouding van lang tot kort nageslag in ’n Tt × Tt-kruising?
items.explain: The genotypes are 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt, so the phenotypes are 3 tall : 1 short.
items.explainAf: Die genotipes is 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt, dus is die fenotipes 3 lang : 1 kort.

items.q: In a horse breed with incomplete dominance, a cream (CrCr) and a chestnut (ChCh) horse produce palomino offspring (CrCh). If two palominos are crossed, what is the phenotypic ratio of cream : palomino : chestnut?
items.qAf: In ’n perderas met onvolledige dominansie gee ’n room (CrCr) en ’n kastaiing (ChCh) ’n palomino-nageslag (CrCh). As twee palominos gekruis word, wat is die fenotipiese verhouding van room : palomino : kastaiing?
items.explain: The genotypes are 1 CrCr : 2 CrCh : 1 ChCh, which gives a phenotypic ratio of 1 : 2 : 1.
items.explainAf: Die genotipes is 1 CrCr : 2 CrCh : 1 ChCh, wat ’n fenotipiese verhouding van 1 : 2 : 1 gee.

items.q: In a pedigree, which pattern indicates an autosomal recessive trait?
items.qAf: Watter patroon in ’n stamboom dui op ’n outosomaal resessiewe eienskap?
options: Two unaffected parents have an affected child
An affected parent always has affected children
The trait appears only in males in every generation
The trait is never skipped a generation
optionsAf: Two unaffected parents have an affected child
An affected parent always has affected children
The trait appears only in males in every generation
The trait is never skipped a generation
items.explain: Unaffected carriers can have an affected child, which is typical of a recessive trait.
items.explainAf: Onaangetaste draers kan ’n aangetaste kind hê, wat tipies van ’n resessiewe eienskap is.

items.q: CADASIL is an autosomal dominant disorder. Two unaffected parents have a child. What is the probability that the child is affected?
items.qAf: CADASIL is ’n outosomaal dominante versteuring. Twee onaangetaste ouers het ’n kind. Wat is die waarskynlikheid dat die kind aangetas is?
items.explain: Both parents are dd, so all their children are dd and unaffected.
items.explainAf: Albei ouers is dd, dus is al hul kinders dd en onaangetas.

items.q: Two carriers (Aa × Aa) of a recessive disorder have a child. What is the probability that the child is affected?
items.qAf: Twee draers (Aa × Aa) van ’n resessiewe versteuring het ’n kind. Wat is die waarskynlikheid dat die kind aangetas is?
items.explain: Aa × Aa gives aa in 1 of 4 offspring, so 25%.
items.explainAf: Aa × Aa gee aa in 1 uit 4 nageslae, dus 25%.

items.q: Inheritance in which neither allele is dominant and the heterozygote shows an intermediate phenotype.
items.qAf: Oorerwing waarin geen alleel dominant is nie en die heterosigoot ’n tussenin-fenotipe toon.

items.q: Inheritance in which both alleles are expressed equally in the heterozygote, as in AB blood.
items.qAf: Oorerwing waarin beide allele ewe veel in die heterosigoot uitgedruk word, soos by AB-bloed.

items.q: The position of a gene on a chromosome.
items.qAf: Die posisie van ’n geen op ’n chromosoom.

items.q: The pair of chromosomes that determines sex.

items.text: Haemophilia and colour blindness are [[]]-linked. They are more common in males because males have only one [[]] chromosome.
items.textAf: Hemofilie en kleurblindheid is [[]]gekoppeld. Hulle kom meer by mans voor omdat mans net een [[]]-chromosoom het.

items.q: A female can be a carrier of haemophilia without having the disease.
items.qAf: ’n Vrou kan ’n draer van hemofilie wees sonder om die siekte te hê.
items.explain: True. A carrier female has one normal and one affected X chromosome (XᴴXʰ).
items.explainAf: Waar. ’n Draervrou het een normale en een geaffekteerde X-chromosoom (XᴴXʰ).

items.q: The father decides the sex of a child because he can give an X or a Y chromosome.
items.qAf: Die vader bepaal die geslag van ’n kind omdat hy ’n X- of ’n Y-chromosoom kan gee.
items.explain: True. All eggs carry an X; sperm carry an X or a Y.
items.explainAf: Waar. Alle eiers dra ’n X; sperms dra ’n X of ’n Y.

items.q: A red-flowered plant (RR) is crossed with a white-flowered plant (WW) showing incomplete dominance. The F1 plants are crossed. What percentage of the F2 is expected to be pink?
items.qAf: ’n Rooiblomplant (RR) word met ’n witblomplant (WW) gekruis wat onvolledige dominansie toon. Die F1-plante word gekruis. Watter persentasie van die F2 word verwag om pienk te wees?
items.explain: F1 = RW (pink). RW × RW gives RR, RW, RW, WW: 2 of 4 = 50% pink.
items.explainAf: F1 = RW (pienk). RW × RW gee RR, RW, RW, WW: 2 uit 4 = 50% pienk.

items.q: A man with blood group A and a woman with blood group B have a child with blood group O. Give the genotypes of both parents and explain.
items.qAf: ’n Man met bloedgroep A en ’n vrou met bloedgroep B het ’n kind met bloedgroep O. Gee die genotipes van albei ouers en verduidelik.
points: The child (ii) must have received a recessive i allele from each parent.
pointsAf: Die kind (ii) moes ’n resessiewe i-alleel van elke ouer ontvang het.
